notes: This build makes the view-only accounts honest. A view-only login — the God audit account, and a CEO or MD who has not been switched into edit mode — is refused every change by the server, but the app was still drawing the buttons, so tapping one produced an error instead of doing nothing visible. Those calls are now stopped in the app itself and answered with the reason, and the two screens that exist only to make changes — Calendar Upload, and Logo & Signatures — are no longer offered to an account that cannot use them. Reading is untouched: every list, report, payslip preview and Excel export still works exactly as before, which is the point of a view-only account. Nothing changes for anyone who could already make changes. Also in this build, from 2.6.0: you can ask for a payslip for any month rather than only the months payroll has already been run for. Open Payslips and tap Request a payslip; months you cannot ask for say why, you can add a line explaining why you need it, and you can withdraw a request HR has not started on. For HR, a request for a month that was never run arrives in Payslip Requests marked Not run, offering Generate or Decline, and approving the figures is now a button on that same screen rather than a trip to Payroll and back.
